tagline: Auto-triggered skills: brainstorm → plan → TDD, any harness.

phases.label: Brainstorm
phases.note: brainstorming skill: refine the idea via questions, present the design in readable chunks, save a design document.

phases.label: Write plan
phases.note: writing-plans skill: break work into 2–5 minute tasks, each with exact file paths, full code, and verification steps.

phases.label: Subagent TDD
phases.note: subagent-driven-development: fresh subagent per task, true RED/GREEN/REFACTOR TDD, YAGNI/DRY enforced.

phases.label: Code review
phases.note: requesting-code-review skill: review against the plan; critical issues block progress.

phases.label: Finish branch
phases.note: finishing-a-development-branch: verify tests, merge / PR / keep / discard, clean up the worktree.

scenarios.note: HARD-GATEs still run brainstorm + TDD for a one-liner — **disciplined but heavier** than a direct edit.
Brainstorm → plan → subagent TDD is **purpose-built for building features autonomously**.
Design doc + bite-sized plan + TDD handle cross-file refactors well.
TDD-first (write the failing test) suits bugs, but the brainstorm gate slows a true emergency.
Worktree isolation helps, but it dispatches subagents serially — **not a multi-team orchestrator**.
The plan can enumerate every site; subagents grind through them with review gates.

keyFeatures: Skills auto-trigger from the task — no special commands needed
Subagent-driven development: fresh context per task keeps the window clean
Enforced RED/GREEN/REFACTOR TDD with HARD-GATEs (YAGNI, DRY)
Native git-worktree isolation via the using-git-worktrees skill
Multi-harness: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot CLI, OpenCode, Factory Droid
MIT, ~214K stars; methodology + plugin marketplace ecosystem
limitations: A methodology + skill bundle, not a single installable CLI
Discipline overhead (brainstorm + TDD gates) is heavy for trivial edits
Plans are consumed during execution — no maintained living spec
Per-harness install; behavior varies with the underlying agent
No dashboard or parallel multi-team orchestration
